coordinateSystem: EXIF-oriented original image pixels, origin at top left; x right, y down
orientationNote: These coordinates refer to the photos as a browser displays them after applying EXIF orientation. For canvas/Pillow processing, apply EXIF transpose first. Do not use the un-oriented raw JPEG pixel order.

upper-left.exclude: Everything outside frontQuad, including the left exterior side panel, neighbouring box at right, the lower box's top surface below, and turntable/background above.
upper-left.notes: Front white frame is the narrow coplanar rim. The interior left/right wall and bottom shelf remain photographed depth cues inside openingQuad; do not use them to set the front plane corners. Outer bottom-right corrected to exclude shadow below the frame.

lower-left.exclude: Upper box and its bottom front edge at the top of the image; grey exterior side at left; floor outside left, right and bottom of the quad.
lower-left.notes: Top white front rail is slightly occluded by the upper box overhang near centre/right. Use the lower rail's own edge, rather than the overlapping upper box. Bottom edge is nearly level and slopes down slightly toward right.

upper-middle.exclude: Turntable/background above; neighbouring furniture at left; wall/outlet at right; especially the lower box's top surface protruding to the right/below the photographed upper box.
upper-middle.notes: One physical central divider. Bottom-right is approximately [3006,2686], not the lower box's protruding top corner near [3170,2670]. This distinction materially improves the projection crop.

lower-middle.exclude: Upper box at top, outlet/background to right, floor to left/right. The missing lower-left frame corner is outside the image, so never stretch the nearest visible image corner to stand in for it.
lower-middle.notes: This close-up clips the lower-left frame corner. Outer corner is extrapolated to y3158, 134px beyond the 3024px image height. Measured outer left edge points x730@y2200, x764@y2400, x799@y2600, x834@y2800, x869@y3000; measured bottom edge points y2933@x2100, y2897@x2300, y2860@x2500, y2823@x2700, y2784@x2900, y2747@x3100. Their fitted intersection is [896,3158]. Keep the generated frame beneath the real projection at the small missing corner, or limit the blend to an inset opening crop.

right.exclude: Neighbouring box at left, outlet/background above, floor below, dark object at right. The top of the box lies outside the frontQuad and must not be projected onto the front face.
right.notes: All four frame corners visible. The larger record/book sleeves at right are part of the actual collection and should remain included.

projectionReview.mappingDirection: Solve the forward homography from oriented source image pixels to destination front-face CSS pixels. CSS matrix3d applies that forward mapping directly; a canvas inverse-sampling implementation needs the inverse instead.
projectionReview.cssMatrixConvention: For H=[[a,b,c],[d,e,f],[g,h,1]], CSS column-major matrix3d is [a,d,0,g, b,e,0,h, 0,0,1,0, c,f,0,1]. The image must have transform-origin:0 0 and rendered width/height exactly matching the source coordinate system, or source points must be scaled to the actual rendered image size.
projectionReview.targetPlane: Map frontQuad to the generated room's OUTER front-frame quad, not an inner opening quad. Mapping the whole source outer frame to destination inner opening produces oversized rims and a scale jump. Derive the destination opening by applying H to openingQuad.
projectionReview.cameraConsistency: Put the projected source image and interactive spine overlays under the same camera parent transform and transform-origin. Do not separately rescale the source photo during camera zoom.
projectionReview.perspectiveLimitation: A single homography exactly matches the white coplanar frame. Interior shelves and spines are at different depths, so they cannot all be perfectly reprojected to a new camera angle by one planar transform. Use a modest target perspective close to the original and show the original photo's internal depth cues unchanged.
projectionReview.lighting: Original photos are cool/neutral with bright white frames; the generated room is warmer and more directional. Crossfade late in the camera move, apply only a subtle shared warm grade to the photographic layer, and use a narrow edge feather on the rim. Strong filters sacrifice spine readability. Avoid a visibly rectangular photograph panel or frame-sized dark vignette.
projectionReview.qualityChecks: Numerically verify all four source corners land within 0.5 CSS pixel of target corners. Use source-natural-size coordinates only once. Check browser zoom, narrow mobile viewport, EXIF orientation, re-open/resize, and clipped lower-middle bottom-left. Compare pulled sleeve/hotspot position with readable physical spine text.
